steps.title: Extract DNA from Gram‑negative bacteria
steps.instruction: Use the Maxwell RSC cultured cells DNA kit on a Maxwell RSC instrument (Promega) following the manufacturer’s Gram‑negative protocol with an additional RNase treatment; alternatively any extraction method may be used provided the DNA meets quality metrics OD260/280 > 1.8, OD260/230 > 2, and concentration > 12 ng/µL.

steps.title: Extract DNA from Gram‑positive bacteria
steps.instruction: Perform a pre‑lysis treatment to rupture the cell wall according to your own Gram‑positive protocol, then continue with the same Maxwell extraction steps as for Gram‑negative bacteria.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Place the extracted DNA at 4 °C–9 °C until needed; avoid freezing and thawing to prevent additional shearing.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit HS Assay kit and a Qubit fluorometer.

steps.title: Fragment DNA with RBK mix
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL Fragmentation Mix (RB01‑24) per sample (maximum one sample per barcode) to 18.5 µL extracted DNA (200 ng total); pipette‑mix 10 times and spin down. Do not change the input amount based on sample number; a run with 12 × 200 ng barcode mixes is not under‑loaded. If using the RBK114.96 barcode kit, load a maximum of the specified number of barcoded samples per run.

steps.title: Incubate fragmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 30 °C for 2 min, then at 80 °C for 2 min in a thermocycler, and finally cool to 10 °C.

steps.title: Perform 1× AMPure bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up the barcoded samples using a 1× AMPure bead protocol suitable for a 24‑plex run.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the plate and pool all barcoded samples into a 1.5 mL LoBind tube.
Vortex AMPure XP beads for at least 1 min, then add an equal volume of beads to the pooled sample (e.g., 480 µL beads to 480 µL pooled sample for 24‑plex).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min (optional: on a hula mixer).
Spin down and place on a magnetic rack for 2 min; keep on the magnet and remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 1 mL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol without disturbing the pellet; remove ethanol with a pipette each time.
Briefly spin, keep on the magnet, and remove residual ethanol with a P20 tip; dry the pellet for 30 s (do not over‑dry).
Remove the tube from the magnet, resuspend the pellet in 15 µL EB, and incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Pellet the beads on the magnet until the eluate is clear (≥2 min).
Transfer 12 µL eluate to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube; optionally quantify 1 µL with the Qubit dsDNA BR assay. Expected yield ≈150 ng/µL for 24 samples assuming 70 % wash retention.

steps.title: Add RAP adapter
steps.instruction: Combine 1.5 µL RAP (RA) and 3.5 µL Adapter Dilution Buffer (ADB) to make 5 µL RA+ADB mix; add 1 µL of this mix to 11 µL barcoded DNA, flick to mix, spin down, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare flow‑cell priming mix
steps.instruction: Make the FB reagent by adding 30 µL FCT and 5 µL BSA (50 mg/mL) to a tube containing 1170 µL FCF; mix thoroughly. BSA addition is recommended for optimal performance on MinION R10.4.1 flow cells (FLO‑MIN114).

steps.title: Prime flow cell – first load
steps.instruction: Open the priming port (keep SpotON closed), draw back ~30 µL of air using a P1000 and discard the tip; then load 800 µL of the FB priming mix slowly through the priming port using a fresh 1000 µL tip. Save any remaining FB for the second priming step.

steps.title: Prepare final library
steps.instruction: Vortex the final library (LIB) for at least 30 s before mixing with the remaining reagents.

steps.title: Prime flow cell – second load
steps.instruction: Open the SpotON port and, using a fresh P1000 tip, load 200 µL of the remaining FB priming mix through the priming port (dial down, not through SpotON).

steps.title: Load final library onto flow cell
steps.instruction: Immediately load 75 µL of the well‑mixed final library dropwise through the SpotON port, allowing each drop to be taken up before adding the next.

steps.title: Start sequencing run
steps.instruction: Close the SpotON port, then the priming port; place the light shield onto the flow cell and click the green “Start” button in MinKNOW to begin the run.

steps.title: Configure data output and basecalling
steps.instruction: Select output location, choose FASTQ and/or POD5 format (default both), enable barcoding with split files by barcode, set compression, and select raw reads as POD5; then click Continue to Basecalling, choose Super‑accurate live basecalling, enable barcoding and Barcoding Trim, set minimum read length to 200 bp, and turn off Reserve Pores in Advanced options.

steps.title: Set run duration and bias voltage
steps.instruction: Change the default run length from 72 h to 48 h and set the bias voltage to –180 mV.

steps.title: Select library kit and sample metadata
steps.instruction: Choose the library kit used (e.g., SQK‑RBK114.24), optionally specify sample type DNA, PCR‑free status, and multiplexing; provide an experiment name and sample ID (use the flow‑cell barcode number for both).

steps.title: Verify flow‑cell pore count
steps.instruction: Before starting, ensure the flow cell has passed QC with >800 live pores (check in MinKNOW or GridION).

description: Navigate to Sequencing Overview to monitor the run.
